title: Perfect QCoh derived objects are compact on Noetherian schemes
statement: For a Noetherian scheme X with derived categories on X and every open U, every perfect object P of schemeDerivedQCohCategory X is compact.

proof.text: Use the generic perfectObjectCompact theorem. A Noetherian scheme supplies the CompactSpace and QuasiSeparatedSpace instances required by that theorem; the local derived-category hypotheses are exactly its remaining assumptions.

mathlib_searches.query: compact objects perfect derived category Noetherian scheme

lean.statement:
theorem noetherian_perfect_compact (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [hOpen : ∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    let _ : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) := derivedQCohDirectSums X
    ∀ (P : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X), Scheme.IsPerfect X P.obj → IsCompactObject P
